Sergeant Thrinn is a duergar cultist at Grymforge in Act One. She has tasked several duergar to retrieve her stolen boots.
“
Move, hoon. I don't have time for drugnin' outsiders.
„
— Elenna Thrinn

Involvement

Act One

Main article: Free True Soul Nere

Thrinn is in the duergar encampment in Grymforge at X: -643 Y: 300, where she is organizing the rescue attempt to free  Nere from the cave-in. She is in charge of the duergar in Nere's absence.

If the party side with Nere, but he dies during the ensuing battle, Thrinn can be convinced to let the gnomes go:

  • [ILLITHID] Draw on the power within to enforce your will.
  • [ILLITHID] [WISDOM] Call on the parasite, connect with Thrinn. 'The gnomes must go free.' (DC 10)
  • [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION] FREE THEM, OR ELSE. (DC 10 )
  • [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM] Read Thrinn's thoughts.
    • The gnomes won't survive the curse. What good is a gift of corpses?

She can be given the  Boots of Speed, thus completing ⁠Find the Missing Boots. The party can choose either  Bracing Band or  Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo as a reward.

Idle banter

Thrinn berating the enslaved deep gnomes:

  • Sergeant Thrinn
    Back on your feet, or I'll bite your toes off, one by one!
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    I'll peel your balls like potatoes if you don't move!
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    And you better hope that's the worst of it.
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    The slowest one of you lot is gettin' tossed to a rothé in heat!
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    You pricks got some nerve. Clean up this mess.
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    Nere dies, heads roll!
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    And that goes for novices too!

Greymon announcing the party to Thrinn:

  • Sergeant Thrinn
    What?
  • Corsair Greymon
    Outsiders, ma'am. They've killed the gnome. The fast one. They've got your boots.
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    Good. You're dismissed.
  • Corsair Greymon
    Outsiders, ma'am. They have news of Gekh Coal.
  • Corsair Greymon
    He failed. Myconids killed him and his squad.
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    Gh'rack. Useless rakkah.
  • Corsair Greymon
    Uhm...
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    What? You're dismissed.
  • Corsair Greymon
    Outsiders, ma'am. They're with the Absolute.
  • Sergeant Thrinn
    Great. More trouble. You're dismissed.
